notes: What the engine needs from the private-views component: per-viewer redaction of hidden game facts. Each record has an owner, open facts everyone sees, hidden facts only the owner sees until revealed, and a revealed map saying which hidden keys (true) or which indexes of an array (number[]) are now public.

redact.returns: Record<string,unknown>[] (one per record, same order: open facts plus each hidden key as its value if the viewer owns it or it is revealed, else null; a null viewer is a display and sees only revealed)
